mapper.select: SELECT a.assignment_id as a_assignment_id, a.course_id as a_course_id, a.title as a_title, a.description as a_description, a.deadline as a_deadline, a.max_score as a_max_score, c.course_name as c_course_name, -- 【【添加】】查询课程名称，并使用别名 c_course_name s.submission_id as s_submission_id, s.assignment_id as s_submission_assignment_id, -- 【建议】给 submission 表的 assignment_id 也一个明确别名 s.user_id as s_user_id, s.file_path as s_file_path, s.submit_time as s_submit_time, s.status as s_status, s.score as s_score, s.feedback as s_feedback FROM assignments a INNER JOIN -- 【【添加】】与 courses 表进行 INNER JOIN courses c ON a.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN submissions s ON a.assignment_id = s.assignment_id AND s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.deadline ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO submissions (assignment_id, user_id, file_path, submit_time, status) VALUES (#{assignmentId}, #{userId}, #{filePath}, NOW(), '已提交')

INSERT INTO submissions (assignment_id, user_id, file_path, submit_time, status) VALUES (#{assignmentId}, #{userId}, #{filePath}, NOW(), '已提交') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE file_path = VALUES(file_path), submit_time = NOW(), status = VALUES(status)
